# dart_json_mapper

**Tag**: serialization

## 简介

This package allows programmers to annotate Dart objects in order to serialize / deserialize them from / to JSON.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/k-paxian/dart-json-mapper
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/dart_json_mapper
